reviewed: Saved R433 screenshot checkpoints only; no app, simulator, build, or save interaction.

partyAppearances.note: Companion views show each selected appearance attached to the intended actor without obvious clipping or blocking the character. NOIR's green collar is at the neck; the green paw-side item is consistent with her equipped catalyst and is not treated as a misplaced collar.

weaponAppearances.note: Branch and moon staff variants are distinguishable in battle. The moon battle frame shows the four party members and moon staff; capture label/state records 6 seconds into battle. No obvious character, weapon, or enemy occlusion is visible in these frames.

furniture.note: The botanical desk is visible in the room and the reading pose is understandable. Preview text and place/store controls are legible in the saved screens. The stored-state preview shows the room without the desk and exposes the place action.

limits: This review covers only the saved screenshots and checkpoint metadata. At review time no top-level final RUN/closure receipt was present, so I do not independently certify final protected-tree preservation or run closure.
The known LUNA desk-reading mantle issue remains tracked separately under R435; it is not counted as a new finding here.
No formal art approval, VoiceOver/accessibility review, physical-device review, or general wardrobe quality acceptance is inferred.
